newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Q1 steel output rises 10 pct - industry group.
newsitem.headline: German Q1 steel output rises 10 pct - industry group.

text.p: German steel production rose 10 percent in the first quarter of 1997, while orders increased 15 percent, the Wirtschaftsvereinigung Stahl, a steel industry associaion, said on Monday.
Steel prices were also starting to rise after a 10 percent decline in 1996, the group said at the Hanover Industry Trade Fair.

German crude steel output should rise six percent in 1997 to 42 million tonnes, said Ruprecht Vondran, president of the Wirtschaftsvereinigung Stahl in a text prepared for delivery to journalists at the trade fair.
Steel makers' profit should also improve, with all steel makers in the black, while some showed losses in 1996, he said.
The 15 percent decline in the mark versus the dollar has boosted steel as well as other German exporters, Vondran said.
